summary: The wave and the phase carry over. Pedal LFO's target, period in ticks, depth, centre and start switch do not: Neo LFO points at up to 8 parameters itself (modulate, or the target picker in its editor), each with its own depth, and rides on the value the target already has.

rules.why: the same six waves; Neo LFO adds a smooth random wave

unmapped.why: Neo LFO's Rate is in Hz or a tempo length (Sync); Pedal LFO's period is in ticks, which is a different time at every tempo and tracks-per-beat: set Rate or Sync again
depth is per target in Neo LFO (−100 … +100 %, polarity, range): Pedal LFO's one depth and its target are not carried; re-point it with modulate
Neo LFO swings around the value the target parameter already has (its base), not around a centre of its own
Pedal LFO's divisions (1/1 … 1/16, triplets) are Neo LFO's Sync with Feel, which pick the cycle together: set them again
remove the targets (modulation_remove) or mute the machine: the target goes back to its base
Neo LFO runs always; Retrigger restarts it on the beat, the bar or a note

remarks: Pedal LFO drives its target through the host by wiring set in the song; Neo LFO has its own targets, so after machine_replace point it again with modulate(source=…, target_machine=…, param=…).

tolerance.why_not: A control machine makes no sound: what carries over is the wave and the phase, and the target and its depth are set again with modulate.

evidence: Machines/Manifests/Generators/Pedal LFO.machine.json (the shapes, the phase in degrees)
